meta_description: HOKA Midnight Run Asia 2026 Clark: November 15 at Clark City, Philippines. 21K, 10K, and 5K from Runrio — a HOKA-branded night race reviewed.
dek: Set for 15 November 2026 in Clark City, this HOKA-branded midnight run is produced by Runrio — the Philippines' premier race organiser. Three distances. A brand-backed night race in one of the country's best running venues.
verdict: HOKA Midnight Run Asia brings the global performance-running brand's night-race concept to Clark City, produced by Runrio — the gold standard in Philippine race production. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K) and a midnight format on Clark's wide, traffic-free roads. Runrio's involvement guarantees professional timing, well-stocked aid stations, and HOKA-branded race merchandise. Registration isn't open yet, but for a Runrio-HOKA collaboration in one of the Philippines' best running environments, this is a priority track.

sections.heading: Runrio + HOKA: A Premium Combination
paragraphs: Runrio is the Philippines' most respected race organiser — the team behind the MILO Marathon National Finals, the Sante Barley Trilogy, and numerous other marquee events. [1] HOKA's global brand presence adds premium merchandise, marketing reach, and a built-in running-community audience. Clark City's wide roads and midnight format make for a fast, cool-weather race experience.
